svg.text: execution architecture — fans, joins and gates
rows read left → right, then wrap · dashed card = runs only on its condition · bold = key name · italic = condition, bound or opt-out

g.text: FAN · ≤2 CATEGORIES · ≤4 SONNET COORDINATORS · WAVE ORDER FOR all

svg.text: deadline: fast 3120 s · dual 8340 s · full/A/B: ceil((600 + 120 × serial children + Codex allowance) / 60) × 60 s
nested: main → Sonnet pipeline → children · per pipeline: Haiku ≤4 · Sonnet ≤1 · Opus ≤1
Subtract unrelated work; reduce coordinators to fit · routing/rules children serial · timeout keeps slots until stopped

g.text: STANDARD PIPELINE · pipeline-prompt.md · agents · skills · communication
One Sonnet general-purpose pipeline subagent per target

svg.text: Codex runs foreground: 1 batch call · full adds 1 call each for high, extreme

g.text: what each target mode runs · apply = --apply alone
dashed = same stage reused, see its home card
¹ Apply: curator per .md destination; merge approved edits · routing/rules: manual review
‖ = batches within reserved tier caps; collect before next · rules trigger fidelity: unmeasured, metrics null
a ⏱ never answers or skips one
paths that drop blocks or spawns
no Codex bridge → Claude-only, single scorer
Re-runs after a fix (routing, rules ≤3 cycles; 1 apply cycle) are user re-invocations, not loops inside one run.
Diagram only — SKILL.md is normative; update both with any step/gate/fan-out change.
